categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in IC packaging and testing (84% of revenue) and memory module manufacturing (16%). It provides services including ultra-thin plastic IC packaging, ball grid array (BGA), quad flat no-lead (QFN) packaging, memory card packaging, multi-chip packages (MCP), system-in-package (SIP), and module assembly for DRAM and other semiconductor products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor packaging technologies such as flip chip, multi-chip stacking, system-in-package, and wafer bumping. It focuses on process optimization, production efficiency, and energy-saving projects. The company is developing 10nm DDR5 packaging, wafer bump transfer technology, and advanced testing methods including QFN and DDR5 packaging/testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor wafer foundries and memory chip manufacturers, mainly serving the DRAM market. Major end markets include consumer electronics (smartphones, PCs), data centers, AI servers, automotive electronics, and industrial control. Customers are primarily located in Taiwan, the US, China, South Korea, and Hong Kong.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with domestic customers, while also actively expanding overseas markets including the United States, China, South Korea, and Hong Kong. It leverages Taiwan’s complete semiconductor supply chain ecosystem.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in IC packaging, testing, and memory module assembly as a foundry service provider. It acts as a subcontractor for wafer fabs and chip manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing advanced packaging technologies for DDR5 and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), expanding production capacity for new generation products, and enhancing automation and AI-driven manufacturing. The company emphasizes ESG initiatives, energy efficiency, and sustainable development. R&D focuses on multi-chip stacking, flip chip CSP, wafer bumping, and cost-effective packaging solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through contract manufacturing services including IC packaging, testing, and memory module assembly. The company earns fees based on volume and complexity of outsourced semiconductor packaging and testing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly capital-intensive and technology-driven semiconductor packaging and testing industry. It holds a stable market share in Taiwan’s IC packaging sector (about 1.43% of domestic market). Competitors include other global semiconductor packaging and testing foundries. The company leverages its integration with the Formosa Plastics Group and close relationships with major wafer fabs to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately NT$8.93 billion, a 16.8% increase from the previous year, with pre-tax profit rising 77.5%. It employs over 2,300 staff with steady growth in production volume and sales, driven by AI and gaming demand. Capital expenditures focus on expanding capacity with a new factory expected to start production in 2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, diverse product offerings with advanced packaging technologies tailored to customer needs. It provides integrated turnkey services from packaging to module assembly, ensuring fast delivery, cost efficiency, and technical innovation. Strong ESG commitment and sustainable practices further differentiate it in the semiconductor foundry market.
